mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.credit, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.realname AS teacherName, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM courses c INNER JOIN users u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.credit, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.realname AS teacherName, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM course_student_rel cs INNER JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN users u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}
